questions.subject: english
questions.question: A .......... came to D. H. Lawrence's water-trough to drink water.
questions.explanation: Kavi D.H. Lawrence ke water-trough par ek pyasa saamp paani peene aaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poet was wearing .......... when he saw the snake at the trough.
questions.explanation: Garmi ka din hone ki wajah se kavi ne us samay pyjamas pehna hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poet had gone down to the water-trough to fetch and drink ..........
questions.explanation: Kavi apne water-trough par ghada lekar paani lene aur peene gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: A snake appears on the trough of the .......... to sip water.
questions.explanation: Saamp paani peene ke liye kavi (poet - D.H. Lawrence) ki paani ki naand par aaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The speaker (poet) felt a strange desire to .......... to the snake.
questions.explanation: Kavi ke man mein saamp se baat karne ('longed to talk to him') ki ichha hui thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The snake met the poet near his water ..........
questions.explanation: Saamp kavi se uski paani ki naand (water-trough) ke paas mila tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The snake seemed like a .......... in exile.
questions.explanation: Kavi ko saamp paatal lok ke ek nishkasit raja ('king in exile') ki tarah laga.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poet compares the snake to a sea bird named ..........
questions.explanation: Kavi saamp par lathha phenkne ke baad pachhtawe mein uski tulna 'albatross' pakshi se karta hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which tree is explicitly mentioned in the poem 'Snake'?
questions.explanation: Kavita mein carob ke bade aur ghane ped ('great dark Carob tree') ka ullekh hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poem 'Snake' has been composed by ..........
questions.explanation: 'Snake' kavita prasiddh lekhak aur kavi D. H. Lawrence dwara likhi gayi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In .......... according to the poem 'Snake', black snakes are considered innocent.
questions.explanation: Sicily mein yeh maanyata thi ki kaale saamp nirdosh hote hain aur sunahre zahreele hote hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Mount Etna, mentioned as smoking in the poem, is situated in ..........
questions.explanation: Etna jwalamukhi Sicily (Italy) mein sthit hai jahan kavi us samay rah rahe the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'And stooped and drank a little more' is taken from which poem?
questions.explanation: Yeh pankti D. H. Lawrence ki kavita 'Snake' se li gayi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'He lifted his head from his drinking, as cattle do' is from ..........
questions.explanation: Saamp ke paani peete samay sir uthane ki tulna maveshiyon se 'Snake' kavita mein ki gayi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: D. H. Lawrence exalts the values of .......... life in the poem 'Snake'.
questions.explanation: Lawrence aadhunik dikhawati jeevan ki jagah aadim aur prakritik (primitive) jeevan ke mulyon ki prashansa karte hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Someone was before me at my water trough; and I, like a second comer, waiting' is from ..........
questions.explanation: Yeh prasiddh pankti 'Snake' kavita ki hai jisme kavi khud ko doosra aane wala mehmaan maante hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poet experiences a mixed feeling of awe and being .......... the snake.
questions.explanation: Kavi saamp ki shaan dekhkar aashcharyachakit bhi the aur sath hi usse bhaybheet (afraid of) bhi the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was D. H. Lawrence born?
questions.explanation: D. H. Lawrence ka janam 11 September 1885 ko hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year did D. H. Lawrence pass away?
questions.explanation: D. H. Lawrence ka nidhan saal 1930 mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: D. H. Lawrence grew up in the mining village of Eastwood in ..........
questions.explanation: Lawrence ka bachpan Nottinghamshire ke Eastwood naamak khanik gaon mein beeta tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In his literary writings, D. H. Lawrence emerged as the champion of ..........
questions.explanation: Lawrence manav ke bheetar ki swabhavik preranaon aur sahaj pravritti (instinct) ke mukhya champion the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which of the following celebrated novels was authored by D. H. Lawrence?
questions.explanation: 'Sons and Lovers' (1913) D. H. Lawrence ka vishva-vikhyat upanyas hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What object did the poet throw at the water-trough to scare the snake?
questions.explanation: Kavi ne saamp ke pichhe ek bedhab lakdi ka lathha ('a clumsy log') utha kar phenka tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: From where did the snake emerge to reach the water-trough?

options.B: From a fissure in the earth-wall

questions.explanation: Saamp mitti ki deewar ki ek daraar ('a fissure in the earth-wall') se nikal kar aaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How is the colour of the Sicilian snake described in the poem?
questions.explanation: Kavita mein saamp ka rang mitti jaisa bhoora aur sunahra ('earth-brown, earth-golden') bataya gaya hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What did the voice of the poet's social education command him to do?
questions.explanation: Kavi ki manviya shiksha aur samajik soch ne use saamp ko maarne ('He must be killed') ke liye kaha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How did the poet feel immediately after throwing the log at the snake?
questions.explanation: Lathha phenkte hi kavi ko turant ghor aatm-glani aur pachhtawa ('immediately I regretted it') hua.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poet severely despised his action as being ..........
questions.explanation: Kavi ne apne is kanoon-viheen kaam ko tuchh, ashleel aur neech ('paltry, vulgar, mean act') kaha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poet condemned the voices of his .......... for urging him to strike.
questions.explanation: Kavi ne apni shaapit manviya shiksha ('accursed human education') ko kosa jisne use hinsa sikhayi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What did the snake do with its tongue while drinking water?

options.B: Bit the edge of the stone

questions.explanation: Saamp ne paani peene ke dauran apni kaali do-munhi jeebh ('two-forked tongue') bahar nikaali.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The snake looked around like an unseeing .......... into the air.
questions.explanation: Kavi likhte hain ki saamp ne hawa mein bina dekhe ek devta ki tarah ('looked around like a god, unseeing') dekha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The reference to the albatross bird is an allusion to a famous poem by ..........
questions.explanation: Albatross ka zikr S.T. Coleridge ki prasiddh kavita 'The Rime of the Ancient Mariner' se juda hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What did the poet realize he had to expiate at the end of the poem?
questions.explanation: Kavita ke aakhiri hisse mein kavi kehte hain ki unhe apni tuchhta ('A pettiness') ka prayashchit karna hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poet felt honoured because the snake sought his ..........
questions.explanation: Kavi ko garv hua ki saamp ne zameen ke andhere dware se nikal kar unki mehmaannawazi (hospitality) maangi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which month did the speaker's encounter with the snake occur?
questions.explanation: Yeh ghatna Sicily ki tapte huye mahine July ('Sicilian July with Etna smoking') ke din hui thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What occupation did D. H. Lawrence's father pursue?
questions.explanation: D. H. Lawrence ke pita koyle ki khadaan mein kaam karne wale kanooni mazdoor (miner) the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which novel among the following was NOT written by D. H. Lawrence?
questions.explanation: 'The Great Gatsby' F. Scott Fitzgerald ka upanyas hai, jabki baki teeno Lawrence dwara likhe gaye hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How did the snake react when the log struck near the water-trough?

options.B: It convulsed in undignified haste and writhed like lightning

questions.explanation: Lathha phenke jaane par saamp ka bacha hua sharir bijli ki tarah tadap kar tezi se bil mein sama gaya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poet envisions the snake as a king uncrowned in the ..........
questions.explanation: Kavi ne saamp ko paatal lok ('uncrowned in the underworld') ka be-taj badshah maana hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What utensil was the poet carrying when he came down the steps?
questions.explanation: Kavi paani bharne ke liye apne haath mein ghada ('pitcher') lekar seedhiyon se utra tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does D. H. Lawrence strongly denounce through the poem 'Snake'?

options.B: Shams and artificialities of modern civilized life

questions.explanation: Lawrence aadhunik sabhyata ke jhoothe aadarsho aur banawatipan ki kadi ninda karte hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How did the snake sip water from the dripping tap?

options.B: Softly through its straight gums and mouth

questions.explanation: Saamp ne shaanti se apne seedhe masoodon aur munh se paani ki chuski li.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What central conflict is explored in D. H. Lawrence's 'Snake'?

options.B: Inner conflict between social conditioning and natural instinct
options.C: Class divide between rich and poor

questions.explanation: Kavita mein manav ki samajik shiksha aur aatmik sahaj pravritti ke beech ka dwandv dikhaya gaya hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the meaning of the word 'fissure' in the poem?

options.A: A narrow crack or split opening

questions.explanation: 'Fissure' ka arth deewar ya chattano mein bani patli daraar ya chhidra hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the most suitable antonym of 'pettiness' as used in the poem?
questions.explanation: 'Pettiness' (tuchhta/chhotapan) ka sahi vipritarthak shabd 'Magnanimity' (udaarta/badaapan) hota hai.
